capabilities: Saves scroll positions per tab, pane and mode
Restores positions when files or tabs are reopened
Creates named position bookmarks with search, jump and removal
Exports and imports position data as JSON
Cleans up expired position records on startup
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.8.0 or later. Smart Restore Delay is marked Beta. main.js is not in the source repository and must be downloaded from GitHub Releases. Interface available in Chinese and English.
problem: Obsidian reopens notes at the top, so readers and editors lose their place when switching between files and tabs.
summary: Plugin that saves and restores Markdown scroll positions per tab and pane, with named position bookmarks and a status bar control.
